  Exam Date & Time: 16-Jan-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS -JANUARY 2024  
  SUBJECT: CSE 1071 / CSE_1071 - PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS  
  PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS [CSE 1071]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Describe the terms application software, system software and hardware with suitable  
  examples for each.                                                                       (2)  
  
  1B)          XYZ company's regular work hours are 45 hours a week. The company pays overtime to  
  its employees for working beyond regular hours. The overtime rate is Rs. 100 per hour.  
  Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to calculate the overtime pay for an employee (3)  
  based on the number of hours worked beyond the standard work hours.  
  
  1C)          Evaluate the following expression by showing all the intermediate steps:  
  $$i) ((5 == 5) || (3 > 6) = ?$$  
  $$ii) 7 == 5 ? 4 : 3 = ?$$  
  $$iii) If a = 2, b = 3 and c = 6; then (b + 4 > a * c) = ?                                 (5)$$  
  $$iv) The expression: a=7/22*(3.14+2)*3/5 will evaluates to = ?$$  
  $$v) K = num > 10 ? num < = 20 ? 100 : 200 : 500; where num =30$$  
  
  2A)          Explain the concept of operator precedence and associativity in C programming.  
  Consider the expression a + b * c / d - e * (f + g).  
  Describe the order of operations for evaluating this expression based on the precedence  
  of operators. Provide a step-by-step breakdown of the evaluation process, including the (3)  
  intermediate results.  
  Additionally, demonstrate how the use of parentheses can alter the order of operations in  
  the expression.  
  
  2B)          i) Identify the valid declaration statement.  
  a) float _mark;  
  b) float 16_mark;  
  c) float #mark_16;                                                                       (2)  
  d) float #mark;  
  
  ii) List the rules for valid variable name in C.  
  
  2C)          i) Mr. Ram bought a new bike. He wants to get it registered in the RTO office. Mr. Ram (5)  
  believes that palindrome numbers are lucky for him. He wants to check if a given  
  number is a palindrome or not. Write a C program to help him.  
  ii) Write a C program to search an element of a given 1D array and arrange the given  
  elements in ascending order using selection sort. Use switch case to specify either search

  or selection sort.  
  
  
  3A)             Write a program which reads a matrix of size M x N and checks whether elements are in  
  strictly ascending order.  
  Example Inputs:  
  $$i) Input: M=2, N=3$$  
  Matrix:  
  123  
  456                                                                                   (2)  
  Output: Elements are in strictly ascending order  
  $$ii) Input: M=2, N=3$$  
  Matrix:  
  122  
  312  
  Output: Elements are not in strictly ascending order  
  
  3B)             Explain any two string handling functions with example. Write a function called  
  myFunc() which takes a string as argument and returns length of a string argument.         (3)  
  (2+1 = 3 marks)  
  
  3C)             Write a C program that reads a square matrix of size N x N and  
  i) Write a function DiagSumCompare() which takes a matrix as argument and displays  
  whether sum of primary diagonal elements is greater than secondary diagonal elements  
  after displaying the respective sum.  
  ii) Write a function BorderNonborderCompare() which takes a matrix as argument and         (5)  
  displays whether sum of all border elements is greater than non-border elements after  
  displaying the respective sum.  
  Call both the functions from main().  
  
  4A)             Distinguish between Call by Value and Call by Reference in C. Write a C program to  
  swap two numbers using the concept of Call by Value and Call by Reference                  (3)  
  
  4B)             List out the Rules to pass a 2D array to a function. Write a C program to add all the even  
  elements of an array using the function Add().                                             (3)  
  
  4C)             Define recursive function. Write a C program to find the sum of digits of a number using  
  recursion.                                                                               (4)  
  
  5A)             Write a C program to compute the average of 'n' array elements using a pointer.  
  (3)  
  
  5B)             Create a structure called time with hours, minutes, and seconds as its members. Write a  
  C program to read start and end times and print the time difference using a function  
  timediff() that accepts two structure variables of type time as input and computes the     (4)  
  time difference.  
  
  5C)             Explain any three cyber-crimes where computers are used to commit the crime.  
  (3)  
  
  
  -----End-----
